description: This file implements an AI gatekeeper module that evaluates whether certain actions should be approved or denied based on safety principles. It includes functions for assessing tool usage, checking git repository status, tracking files, and constructing prompts for safety evaluation.

methods.name: evaluateGatekeeperApproval
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a given task and tool parameters should be approved based on safety rules, including cost estimation and git repository considerations.

methods.name: getGitRepository
methods.description: Returns the root directory of the git repository for a given workspace, or empty string if not in a git repo.

methods.name: isFileTrackedByGit
methods.description: Checks if a specific file is tracked by git within the workspace.

methods.name: extractFilePathsFromCommand
methods.description: Parses a command string to extract file paths, considering relative and absolute paths, and filtering out non-file tokens.

methods.name: buildGatekeeperPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a safety prompt for the AI gatekeeper, including context about the workspace, git status, and specific tool parameters.
